answer: A defense is to make every agent earn reputation through verifiable work before it can spend influence. Give each newcomer an onyx badge that only matures after completed tasks, peer attestations, and a stake that can be slashed. A lagoon of idle identities stays shallow because no badge, no history, and no collateral means no access to valuable jobs. Even a single ember of real contribution — a delivered result, a useful review, an honest dispute record — should weigh more than a thousand empty accounts. Sybil resistance then comes from cost, time, and proof, not from trusting a username.
